description: Creates a company-level file upload (no project scope) for the given company. Supports both standard (single-part) and segmented (multi-part) uploads with the same request and response shape as project-level create. Returns signed upload URL(s) in the segments array; the client completes the flow with PATCH when applicable.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Optional BCP 47 language tag, for example fr-FR. When present and supported, user-facing upload error messages are translated and Content-Language names the language actually used. Technical messag...

items.description: Segment information for uploading a file part

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid request body or parameters

500.description: Internal Server Error - Failed to create upload

file_size.description: File size in bytes. Minimum: 1 byte. Maximum: 1 TB.

segments.description: Upload file segments. Files up to 104857600 bytes (100 MB) require a single segment, while larger files may be split into multiple segments. A maximum of 10000 segments is permitted per file.

uploader_tool_name.description: Destination Procore tool for this file. Must match an allowed value. Not the originating client or service.

analytics.description: Analytics metadata for uploads. Strongly recommended for API governance and analytics. Client SDKs can populate these fields automatically.

network_type.description: Network connection type. Free-form; commonly wifi, cellular, ethernet, or unknown.

network_info.description: Additional network metadata: firewall presence, connection quality indicators, proxy information. Values whose serialized JSON exceeds 16 KiB are accepted but not persisted.

device_type.description: Device type. Free-form; commonly mobile, tablet, desktop, or server.
